anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius, broad convex curve extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with high vertical thickness relative to length, ending in a rounded distal point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle at the intersection where the melon slope meets the superior rostrum plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Mottled pale depigmentation patches across the dorsal melon and head; faint vertical linear marks on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark ocular patch; sharp contrast line between the dark dorsal mantle and the lighter ventral integument.
